title: Buzzing
tagline: We're creating a decentralized platform where you can bet on your favorite creators' future popularity by predicting unique engagement scores—powered by real-time social media data and AI-verified polls.
description:
We're building a decentralized platform that empowers users to wager on the future performance of content creators by predicting the exact engagement score they’ll achieve at the end of a betting pool. Unlike binary betting systems—where an incorrect guess might result in a total loss—our platform offers a more nuanced approach where the loss is proportional to how far your prediction deviates from the actual score. Here’s what sets our platform apart:



Score-Based Predictions:  

  Instead of simply choosing "yes" or "no," users forecast the precise score a content creator will obtain. This means:

  - If your prediction is slightly off, you might only lose a small portion (e.g., 10% of your stake).

  - If it's significantly off, the loss could be higher (up to 60–70%), but never your entire bet.



Advanced AI-Driven Analysis:  

  Our system leverages cutting-edge AI to process real-time data from platforms such as LinkedIn, GitHub, Farcaster, and Discord. This includes:

  - Using natural language processing and machine learning to accurately calculate engagement scores.

  - Detecting any anomalies or potential manipulation in the data, ensuring fair outcomes.



Enhanced Security with zkTLS:  

  To maintain a secure and decentralized environment:

  - We employ zkTLS technology to protect data transmission and verify the results after each betting pool concludes.

  - This cryptographic verification guarantees that the poll outcomes are tamper-proof and trustworthy.



By combining these elements, our platform not only allows users to bet on the growth of content creators but also mitigates risk through a proportional loss mechanism and reinforces trust with robust AI analytics and zkTLS verification.

User Roles & Permissions :Regular Users: Can deposit funds, place bets, create markets, and withdraw winnings. Market Creators: Can set up betting markets by defining event parameters and resolution criteria. AI Resolver: An AI agent responsible for fetching, analyzing, and verifying social media data for market resolution. Administrators (Optional): Oversee platform integrity, dispute resolution, and governance. We use this mainly for dashboarding (getting stats)
